Is’haq said, ‘Muhammad Bin Al Rbi’e Al Shai’e informed me saying, 
‘I looked at a man from the Dualists (believers in two gods) in Al-Ahvaz, then I proceeded to Surmanrayy (Samarrah), and something from his speech was hanging upon my heart.

So I sat at the door of Ahmad Bin Al-Khazeyb when Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) came over from the Public house on the day of the (Sultan’s) procession. So he<sup>asws</sup> looked towards me and gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> forefinger: ‘One! One! Individual! (There is only one God)’.
So I fell down, there being unconsciousness upon me’.
